articles.title: Minnesota Twins, assistant GM Daniel Adler mutually part ways: Sources
articles.description: Adler first joined the Twins in 2017 as the team’s director of baseball operations and was promoted to assistant GM in 2019.

articles.title: Aaron Sabato was ready to go home. Then the Twins told him his flight was going to San Francisco
articles.description: "I never quit, and I never gave up," Sabato said Monday. "It was a complete 180 switch, but it's everything I've ever dreamed of." ...

articles.title: Giants broadcaster Mike Krukow raves about Twins’ Brooks Lee. He’s known him since birth
articles.description: Krukow, whose connection with Lee's family dates back generations, praised Lee on the Giants' broadcast after he hit a solo home run Monday.

articles.title: Emmanuel Rodriguez emotional after Twins call-up: ‘Full disclosure: I cried’
articles.description: Rodriguez missed nearly three months of minor-league action after suffering a torn ulnar collateral ligament in his left thumb on May 1.

articles.title: Twins aim for prospect Kaelen Culpepper to return this season despite going on IL
articles.description: MINNEAPOLIS — Kaelen Culpepper is headed to the injured list with only 11 games remaining, but the Minnesota Twins’ goal is for him to return before the season ends.
